payload.title: GHA-PR-LLM-AC-009: Allow skip label to suppress AC bot runs
payload.body:
## Summary

Let maintainers **suppress** the workflow (no LLM call, no spam) when a configured label (e.g. `skip-ac-check`) is present on the PR, with policy documented per repo.

## Scope

- In scope: Configurable label name (default documented), early exit with **no** comment or a single short “skipped” notice (pick one and document).
- Out of scope: Fine-grained RBAC beyond label presence.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] When the PR has the configured **skip label**, the workflow **does not** invoke the LLM and **does not** post the full AC review comment (per product choice: silent skip vs one-line notice — document which).
- [ ] Default label name and override mechanism (repo variable) are documented.
- [ ] Test or scripted verification covers labeled vs unlabeled PR payload handling.

## Dependencies

- Depends on: GHA-PR-LLM-AC-005
- Blocks: none

## Notes

Align with PRD §8 optional repo variable to enable/disable the whole workflow — avoid conflicting semantics between “disabled” and “skip label.”

PRD: https://github.com/hyperjumptech/mediapulse/blob/prds/pr-github-llm-ticket-acceptance.prd.md
